name: arithmetic-addition
issue_title: Fix add returning the wrong result
issue_body: The add(a, b) function subtracts b instead of adding it. Preserve subtract and make the smallest safe correction.

name: slug-normalization
issue_body: slugify must lowercase text, trim it, collapse repeated whitespace and join words with hyphens.

name: numeric-clamp
issue_body: clamp currently applies the lower and upper bounds in the wrong order. Values below, inside and above the interval must work.

name: pagination-offset
issue_body: The pagination offset for one-based pages must be zero-based for the database: page 1 starts at 0.

name: stable-deduplication
issue_body: deduplicate must remove repeated values while preserving deterministic first-seen order.

name: email-normalization
issue_body: Email normalization must trim surrounding whitespace and lowercase the address for case-insensitive lookup.

name: retry-backoff
issue_body: The retry backoff is linear. retry_delay must return base_seconds * 2**attempt so attempt zero uses the base delay.

name: inclusive-date-range
issue_body: inclusive_days must count both the start and end dates, including a same-day range as one day.

name: boolean-config-parser
issue_body: The boolean parser treats every non-empty string as true. parse_bool should recognize 1, true, yes and on case-insensitively; other values are false.

name: tenant-cache-key
issue_body: The cache key currently collides across tenants. Include the tenant namespace before the user id.
